lifecycle_model.CURRENT: Current governed candidate/proposal state with no material unresolved audit defect inside its approved scope.
lifecycle_model.CURRENT_SCOPED: Current and usable only in named governed scope; broader use requires new governance.
lifecycle_model.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Current object may remain registered, but metadata, rationale, phonology, semantics or dependency requires explicit review before broader promotion.
lifecycle_model.DEPENDENCY_BLOCKED: Current object depends materially on GATE/WATCH/unresolved input and cannot broaden until dependency is resolved.
lifecycle_model.HISTORICAL_PRIOR: Preserved provenance artifact documenting how a later canonical/current state was reached; not current language authority.
lifecycle_model.SUPERSEDED_BY: Artifact should remain for history but must point to a later governing artifact once that artifact exists.
lifecycle_model.RETIRED_PROPOSAL: Noncanonical proposal no longer suitable as an active design input; preserve as history only.
lifecycle_model.AUDIT_ONLY: Audit artifact describing evidence/debt; never itself language canon.
